message.reasoning_content: Help! album: With a Little Help, I Need You, and I Don't Want to Spoil the Party are all on it. Hmm, only one answer allowed. All three first released on Help! (US), except "I Don't Want to Spoil the Party" first on Beatles for Sale (UK) but Help! US came earlier? Beatles for Sale released Dec 1964; Help! US soundtrack Aug 1965. So first released on Beatles for Sale. So two candidates remain. Ambiguous... "With a Little Help from My Friends" is the most famous one on Help!.
